description:
Web Developer, Mid The Opportunity: 
 Develop, enhance, and sustain mission-critical, media-rich web applications for the U.S. Army. Build responsive interfaces, backend services, and APIs using TypeScript in an on-premises environment. Use Redis as a primary application datastore for persistence, caching, and state management, and Nginx to host, route, and deliver reliable web and streaming media services.

 Under the direction of the Engineering Manager or Technical Lead, engineer dependable, low-latency video streaming and playback while improving performance, security, and availability across browsers, services, servers, and local networks. Collaborate with software, systems, and test engineers to troubleshoot integration and delivery issues, validate fixes, and maintain solutions aligned with deployed-system configurations and mission needs. This position is located in Fort Belvoir, VA.

 Join us. The world can't wait.

 You Have:  
 3+ years of experience with professional web development building and supporting full-stack TypeScript applications and with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, asynchronous programming, REST APIs, and core data structures
 Experience applying secure coding practices, Git, code reviews, and automated unit or integration tests
 Experience engineering applications that use Redis as a primary datastore, not solely as a cache, including data modeling and key design, Redis data structures and applicable modules or extensions, caching and state-management patterns, persistence and recovery mechanisms, and performance tuning
 Experience implementing or integrating browser-based video streaming using HLS, MPEG-DASH, or WebRTC
 Experience deploying, configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting web applications on local or on-premises Linux infrastructure using Nginx for web hosting, reverse proxying, load balancing, and high-bandwidth streaming
 Ability to investigate network traffic, application and server performance, and service availability
 Ability to diagnose playback failures, buffering, latency, bandwidth limitations, and media delivery issues
 Secret clearance
 HS diploma or GED
 
 Nice If You Have:  
 Experience supporting U.S. Army, DoD, or federal software development and sustainment programs, including secure development, restricted or disconnected environments, and government security or accessibility expectations
 Experience using FFmpeg, FFprobe, GStreamer, or media tools for transcoding, packaging, stream inspection, and troubleshooting 
 Experience with React, Vue, or Angular, HTML5 video and browser media APIs, and streaming-player libraries such as Hls.js, Video.js, or Shaka Player including responsive design and Section 508 accessibility
 Experience containerizing and deploying TypeScript or Node.js applications with Docker and using CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps within Agile software development and release workflows
 Experience with logging, telemetry, and observability solutions such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Elastic, including monitoring server utilization, application errors, video startup time, buffering, streaming quality, and service availability
 Experience integrating real-time media with operational data, dashboards, or interactive web interfaces using WebSockets, Server-Sent Events (SSE), REST APIs, or Media Source Extensions
 Experience with H.264 or H.265, adaptive-bitrate streaming, and video quality optimization
 Knowledge of secure web and media delivery, including OWASP-aligned application security practices, authentication and authorization, TLS or SSL certificates, firewall and network routing, secure Nginx configuration, and common web vulnerabilities
 
 Clearance:  
 Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Secret clearance is required.

Skills Assessment
As part of Booz Allen’s skills first hiring process, candidates must complete the required skills assessment to ensure they meet the Basic Qualifications for this role. Candidates must complete the assessment and meet the minimum proficiency threshold to continue in the hiring process.
 
 Compensation 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
 
Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $69,400.00 to $158,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allen’s total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date. 
 Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided . 

 Work Model 
Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
 Remote : If this position is listed as remote, there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
 Hybrid : If this position is listed as hybrid, you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen or customer facility, in alignment with your leadership's expectations and the needs of the role.
 Onsite : If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed full-time at a customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.
 
 Commitment to Non-Discrimination 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
